recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. The seed request is already satisfied in current source and rendered output; further core edits would be redundant and could disturb a correct terminology mapping.
issue_request: FHIR-17670 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification PA change request for STU3 Patient-related AdministrativeGender, asking that FHIR code other map to both v2 table 0001 A (Ambiguous) and O (Other), not only A.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 14803, which maps to git commit 879b2dcd6165efa6d784f86d0e3b3523a461abc3. That commit changed ConceptMap narrative/publisher tooling and caches, consistent with the issue being a rendering/tooling problem while bindings.xml already carried both >0001.A and >0001.O.
additional_context: FHIR-16189 and the linked Zulip thread covered duplicate administrative-gender ConceptMap rendering and the same missing second v2 mapping symptom. Current source/fhir.ini keeps Patient active and normative, so the administrative-gender binding evidence is in current core build scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made. On the latest combined branch, source/terminologies/bindings.xml maps AdministrativeGender other to both >0001.A and >0001.O with relationship comments, and build.fhir.org renders both v2 links in the AdministrativeGender value set table.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published PA issue and Zulip-linked comments covered duplicate administrative-gender ConceptMap rendering and the same missing second v2 mapping symptom, but it also had separate SNOMED/duplicate-map scope and was not decided here.
